en.t: Michiko said that someone had read your letter.

units.source_text: 要是她不能从寺院出来，咱们特地从东京赶来不是白搭了吗？

en.t: If she cannot leave the temple, then did we not come all the way from Tokyo for nothing?

units.source_text: 所以你同和尚对弈的时候，我把道子叫来，跟她谈过了。”

en.t: So while you were playing go with the monk, I called Michiko over and talked with her.
